• **Configuration Enhancements**: Expanded Vite/vitest aliases for monorepo dependencies, added

>DocsSearchArtifact.documents[].body and indexed client-side. This undermines the project’s

>

>
>Code >
> >[docsfn/core/src/search.ts[R315-327]](https://github.com/21nCo/super-functions.next/pull/12/files#diff-54c8579b897074a2469189df86c1b29b313dbf61ad1d802d5356fd3ae16e8c0bR315-R327) > >```diff >+ title: redactSensitiveText(page.title), >+ summary: redactSensitiveText( >+ normalizeWhitespace(page.description ?? summarizeBody(page.body)) >+ ), >+ headings: page.headings.map((heading) => redactSensitiveText(heading.text)), >+ tags: [], >+ body: resolveBodyField({ >+ bodyIndexing: input.bodyIndexing, >+ body: page.body, > summary: redactSensitiveText( > normalizeWhitespace(page.description ?? summarizeBody(page.body)) > ), >- headings: page.headings.map((heading) => redactSensitiveText(heading.text)), >- tags: [], >- }); >- } >+ }), >``` >

>
>Description >
> >
>Component blocks call parseBlocks for their children using an idPrefix that only includes
>sourcePath and componentName, so multiple instances of the same component in one page will
>generate identical Mermaid IDs (the Mermaid counter resets per parseBlocks invocation). This can
